continue_prompt: Keep working the errand with your tools. If it is finished, or cannot be finished, call close_case.

messages.private_detail: The email contains a private detail the owner never shares by email.
messages.evidence_missing: for "done", quote the company's written confirmation as evidence. Quote it word for word, or close with another status.
messages.evidence_unmatched: the evidence doesn't match any email from the company. Quote its confirmation word for word, or close with another status.
messages.evidence_unsigned: the email with that confirmation wasn't signed by {domain}, so it can't prove anything. Ask the company to confirm from its own address, or close with another status.
messages.review_rejected: a reviewer read the case and doesn't think it is done yet: {reason} Keep working, or close with another status.
messages.notes_cut: Notes saved, cut to the first {words} words.

instructions.reopened: Said it isn't sorted after all: {reason}

new.start: Your owner has just handed you this errand: please handle this {errand} with {company}.
new.resume: Carry on with the errand from where the brief leaves off.
new.approved: Your owner approved your email "{subject}". It was sent on {day} to {to}.
new.approved_edited: Your owner edited your email "{subject}" before approving it. It was sent on {day} to {to}; the brief shows what was sent.
new.declined: Your owner said no to your email "{subject}": {reason}. Nothing was sent.
new.mail: {day}: {count} new email(s) from the company arrived. They are the latest in the brief.
new.reopened: Your owner says it isn't sorted after all, so the case is open again: {reason}

outcome_check.default_question: Is it sorted? Did {company} do what they confirmed?
